checks.detail: Projection writes are upserts inside the same durable IMMEDIATE transaction; no separate read-modify-write race exists because the whole operation is one short single-writer transaction; results are frozen dataclasses.

Sequence contiguity is checked both incrementally (from last_sequence+1) and during full rebuild (from 1); threshold violations raise before the projection write and roll back, so a failed rebuild never leaves a partial projection.
The SQLite backup API is used instead of file copy, giving a consistent snapshot even under concurrent writes; restore into a fresh target verifies 7/7 rows and the correct max sequence.
All tests create temp directories and never touch real data, authority, operational, policies, inventories, research, or KBase content; protected paths are rejected by contract and by test.
The focused operations suite passes 15/15; the 80-test access/budget/mutation/runner/promotion regression group passes; no production source beyond the two owned files changed.

Spec/quality reviewer actor ids are distinct from the task actor and from each other; invocation ids p7r2-t3-independent-spec-review-20260810 and p7r2-t3-independent-quality-review-20260810 are recorded; external usage is declared UNKNOWN in the completion report.
No blockers exist in the diff, tests, or contract review; no advisory requires follow-up for T3.
